High-performance packet processing and scaling strategies

Excellent teamwork, interpersonal and communication skills.

Drive architecture definition and technical strategy for next-generation Ethernet switch ASICs, enabling scalable, high-performance networking solutions.

description.text:
【Talents who apply job through Qualcomm Career Website will be reviewed and considered as top priority】
Please apply directly on Qualcomm Career Site via link below, and attach your English resume for further review. Thank you!
https://qualcomm.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/zh-CN/External/job/Hsinchu-City-TWN/ASIC-DV-Engineer--Principal-Mgr_3093370
【General Summary】
Education:
MS in EE.
Experience:
10 to 15+ years ASIC design/verification experience. Experience in merchant silicon or switching ASIC (e.g., Broadcom/Marvell/Realtek/MTK networking chips) is highly desirable.
【Requirements】
• Deep expertise in ASIC development, especially switch verification using System Verilog / UVM, SVA and Coverage-driven methodology, Emulation / FPGA validation
• Deep expertise in Ethernet switch architecture, including:
- Forwarding pipelines (L2/L3, ACLs, tunneling)
- Traffic management (QoS, scheduling, shaping)
- High-performance packet processing and scaling strategies
• Strong leadership and cross-functional influence capability
• Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills
• Excellent teamwork, interpersonal and communication skills.
• Fluent in Chinese and English both verbal and written.
• Ability to work in stressful situations with tight schedules to meet.
【Description of Function & Responsibility】
• Drive architecture definition and technical strategy for next-generation Ethernet switch ASICs, enabling scalable, high-performance networking solutions.
• Define verification architecture for Ethernet switch ASICs from Module level, Subsystem level to System level
• Drive cross-functional alignment with HW, SW, and Product teams on networking features and performance verification
• Drive schedule alignment and ensure on-schedule execution with Arch and Design Team
• Mentor senior technical leaders and influence organization-wide engineering direction
